acq_time.Description: Start of acquisition, local time of the acquisition computer. The source carries no timezone.

source_session.Description: Name of the session folder in the lab's deposit.

animals.Description: Number of mice in the arena, from the lab's master sheet.

white_mice.Description: Number of white mice, from the lab's master sheet.

agouti_mice.Description: Number of agouti mice, from the lab's master sheet.

black_mice.Description: Number of black mice, from the lab's master sheet.

obstacle_rating.Description: The lab's rating of the enrichment objects in the arena, verbatim from the master sheet.

bedding.Description: Bedding color, from the lab's master sheet.

difficulty.Description: The lab's difficulty rating, from the number of animals and the enrichment objects.

frames.Description: Frames per camera, from the lab's master sheet.

duration.Description: Duration as the lab's master sheet gives it, in minutes. Blank for six sessions.

notes.Description: Known issues with the session, from the lab README and dataset card.
